description: Equal words and closes retain their different following original context (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $a(candidate) Y $b(candidate) Z
%conditions matches(without-elision($a), rival), ¬matches(without-elision($b), rival)
%rule candidate X [+T]
%rule rival $v(X) [+T]
%conditions begins(after($v), next)
%rule next Y
